# MediaPipe Tasks Vision

Vendored package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`, version `0.10.21`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.21.tgz

License: Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` in this directory. Package code and bundled
WebAssembly are distributed unchanged. Source map files are omitted.

Hand Landmarker model: float16, version 1.

Model source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task

Official usage documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker/web_js

The application loads the runtime and model from its own files. No camera image
or hand landmark data is transmitted to Google or another service.
